# Mitigation Status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MitigationStatus`](gmeow-MitigationStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MitigationStatus>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/risk`](../../slices/risk.md)

The lifecycle status of a mitigation — an OPEN value vocabulary seeded with proposed, active, retired. Retirement is suppression-shaped: a retired mitigation is kept with its status, never deleted ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).
